punchline: Ferriss left for Europe to decide whether to close his company and came back seeing that he was the bottleneck.
thirty_sec: Tim Ferriss ran a sports-nutrition company and worked very long days. He went to Europe for three weeks to decide whether to redesign it or close it, and tried checking email far less. His conclusion: he was the bottleneck. He reorganised so staff could solve problems without him, and that became the 4-Hour Workweek.
